headline: Indonesia Q3 GDP Growth Accelerates to 5.47%, Beating Expectations
summary: Indonesia's economy grew 5.47% year-on-year in the third quarter, expanding faster than expected, according to official data.
why: Indonesia is Southeast Asia's largest economy, making its GDP figures a key indicator of demand and economic activity across the region.

impacts.name: Indonesia
impacts.why: Faster-than-expected GDP growth reinforces macroeconomic resilience in Southeast Asia's largest market.
